generatedProse.practice-connection: From here, reflective practice belongs to your professional life across the School of Sport. Each supervision session, each appraisal, each placement log, clinic note and CPD entry is the same discipline at work: examining your practice honestly, weighing it against the standards of your field, and acting on what you find. The sport scientists, coaches, therapists and managers who keep developing are the ones who keep reflecting critically, and who can show, in writing, that they do.
